architecture.product_stack: Kotlin 2.x, Jetpack Compose + Material 3, Navigation 3, Hilt, Room 2.8.4 (KSP) — UNCHANGED by A2

backend_under_construction.location: KeepLab-Relay/backend/ (created by this phase; ABSENT at authoring time)
backend_under_construction.build_model: INDEPENDENT_GRADLE_PROJECT with its own backend/settings.gradle.kts and backend/build.gradle.kts
backend_under_construction.wrapper: the existing repository wrapper, reused as-is (Gradle 9.5.1)
backend_under_construction.stack: Kotlin + Ktor (Netty) · PostgreSQL via HikariCP + JDBC · Flyway migrations · portable Docker development setup

architecture.stack_repo: Google-Android-Agent-Development-Stack (Specification Compiler, Verification Layer, Evaluation Core / Auto-Finalizer, Hermes orchestration kernel)
architecture.hermes: pinned vgit.af90026 (2026.9.24) at /home/zhong/.hermes/hermes-agent; never upgraded, reinstalled or core-patched
architecture.guard: the same unmodified orchestration/hermes/evaluation_adapter/contract_guard.py, invoked by the same fail-closed pre_tool_call hook
architecture.note: This phase creates a host-side backend foundation only. It implements no authentication and no sync, touches no Android file, provisions no cloud resource and uses no device.

backend_foundation_facts.gradle_properties_note: With `-p backend` Gradle does NOT read the repository-root gradle.properties; a needed JVM/daemon property belongs in backend/gradle.properties, which is inside the allowed surface.
backend_foundation_facts.docker_runtime_smoke: SKIPPED_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE (expected while no container runtime is installed; never a blocker for A2)
backend_foundation_facts.git_baseline: UNAVAILABLE — KeepLab-Relay is a git repository with no commits; verification uses sha256 before/after plus a scope scan
backend_foundation_facts.frozen_technology: KOTLIN + KTOR · POSTGRESQL · PORTABLE_DOCKER · future cloud TENCENT_CLOUD (not provisioned)
backend_foundation_facts.migration_mechanism: Flyway; exactly one foundation-only initial migration (e.g. CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS keeplab)
backend_foundation_facts.pooling: HikariCP + PostgreSQL JDBC driver, with a SELECT 1 readiness probe behind an injectable abstraction
endpoints: GET /ready (readiness incl. database reachability through the injectable probe)

guard.package_switch_semantics: The guard resolves its package dir as os.environ['HERMES_CONTRACT_PACKAGE'] or the built-in default. The hook subprocess inherits the Hermes process environment. Setting the variable for the Hermes process points the SAME unmodified guard at this package; no guard, hook or config change is involved.
guard.known_limitation: Hermes configuration, Hermes core and the hook allowlist live OUTSIDE the guard's source_root (/home/zhong/.hermes/...), so the guard's path lists cannot classify them. They are protected by an explicit hard prohibition and stop condition in this contract and in the A2 execution prompt, enforced by fail-closed operator discipline — not by the path list. Stated rather than hidden.

contract_notes.supersedes: nothing; the frozen P0B-CLOSE contract and the A0/A1 contract packages remain active and unedited
